sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Changes accent colors with a chosen color or Material You.
Adds dark and AMOLED themes with light text and controls.
Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Logan and usage event uploads.
Adds 0.1 dB adjustment, band values and Undo.
Adds named local curves with duplicate, export and import actions.
Removes community, message and support entries.
Stops automatic firmware reminders. Keeps manual update checks.
Enables Xupmix control on Poseidon D80.
